title: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2003, Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2003, Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the horror category, Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
